label: Dependence relata of SCG I.22 nn.2 to 6
term: SCG I.22 dependence relata: conjunction source, absolute dependence, cause of necessity, essence dependence, per se unity
definition: Extends the SCG I.22 contingent-conjunction profile (b18c2550-e953-42d4-817c-cc6805cf5004) with five world-independent primitive relations. conjunctionDependsOn e q s: the joining of esse e to proposed quiddity q depends on s (n.3 'dependet quantum ad coniunctionem', n.4 'eo a quo dependet coniunctio sua'); this is dependence of the union, not of e's being. absolutelyDependsOn e s: e depends on s for its very being, so that e would not be at all unless s were (n.3 'ut omnino non sit nisi illa esset'). necessityFrom e s: s is a cause of e's necessity (necessity per aliud). essenceDependsOn q s: the proposed quiddity q depends on s (n.2 horns (ii) and (iii)). perSeOne e q: e and q are one of themselves, not a union of things which are not of themselves one (n.6 'quae per se non sunt unum'). None is defined by another, none is a modal co-presence condition, and none is identified with the efficient-causal or support relations of other corpus modules.
note: Analyst semantics motivated by SCG I.22 nn.2 to 6 (orientation witness la.wikisource oldid 132346), attribution deferred: no chapter-specific corpus passage has been materialized. Each relation is an explicitly OPEN primitive: its meaning is fixed by this record, and only the OPEN premises of the Chapter22SecondCase module constrain it. Ordinary orientation: a coat of paint's adhesion to a wall depends on the glue (conjunction dependence) without the paint's existence depending on the wall; a reflection depends absolutely on the mirror; a conclusion's necessity is from its premises (necessity per aliud). These examples orient the distinctions only; no verified example of a subsistent esse is available. Structural properties (transitivity, irreflexivity, well-foundedness) are not asserted; in particular self-dependence absolutelyDependsOn e e and necessityFrom e e are not excluded, and a self-sourced joining is kept as an explicit residual case. Distinguished from: NecessarilyUnderived and NoExistingSupportAt (support of bearers, not of an esse or a union), and the modal NecessaryEsseAt. Connection: D-to-E essence-esse identity on the God route (#1595, #319).
